messages:
Dana (People Ops): Quick thread to capture remaining Qs from today's all-hands about the hiring waves, reorg requests, and how we balance ramp load.

Kofi (Head of Eng): We have approval for 12 slots this quarter. Mix of growth + backfills; two infra roles are gated to Dedicated milestones.

Mei (Director, Product): Can we add a cap per team on concurrent ramps? My team can't take 3 new hires during a release.

Dana (People Ops): Yes — default cap = 2 concurrent ramps per team. Exceptions require manager + People Ops sign-off and a short mitigation note.

Rowan (Eng Manager): How will slot reallocation work if priorities change mid-quarter?

Kofi (Head of Eng): Execs can reallocate up to 2 unfilled slots with 48h notice and a rationale; we won't move people mid-ramp. Reallocations apply only to open reqs.

ops-bot: Resource pinned: "Ramp planner & reallocation rules" https://redwood.company/s/people/ramp-planner :pushpin:

Dana (People Ops): Proposed offer waves: 2026-05-12, 2026-06-02, 2026-06-23. We'll annotate geo/pairing flags per req and add mentor-hours guidance.

Mei (Director, Product): Please publish a short FAQ in the tracker with mentor expectations, mobility process, and who to contact for comp exceptions.

Dana (People Ops): Will do. Final tracker + calibration notes will be pinned and we will send a summary email when reqs go live. DM me for edge cases.
